text:
Ariel: who's up for a midnight LAN tonight? thinking 11pm start, 3-4 players, splitscreen/PC mix. projector in mezzanine free? :popcorn:
Jamie: I can bring the PS5 + 2 controllers. happy to swap in Rocket League / Smash. :joystick: :thumbsup:
Sam: I have a spare HDMI-C -> HDMI adapter and a power strip. can drop at desk by 10:30.
Lee: I can bring my gaming laptop and a copy of the map pack for Quake-like mod. who needs keys?
Priya: i'll bring snacks (chips + something vegetarian). also down for co-op campaign.
Ariel: sweet. need one more controller or a USB hub for extra pads. @Jamie can you pack an extra DualSense?
Jamie: yep i'll toss one in the bag. also can bring ethernet switch if anyone wants wired.
Sam: i'll be there around 10:50. can also host a small Steam library share — tell me which titles you want queued.
Lee: put me down for CTF and the map pack. if we get too many folks we can rotate games.
Priya: vote: start at 11 or midnight? react with :one: for 11pm, :two: for midnight.
Ariel: prefer 11 but flexible.
Jamie: :one:
Sam: :two: (late-night wins)
Lee: :one: if we want more sleep tomorrow :sweat_smile:
Priya: :two: (I need more dinner time)
Ariel: looks split. ok let's aim for 11:30 then. middle ground.
calendar-bot: event created: "Midnight LAN / Mezzanine" at 2024-05-07T23:30:00Z (23:30 local).
Ariel: also need projector adaptor — office has only one long HDMI cable. if anyone can bring spare adaptor/hdmi -> usb-c please.
Sam: i got the adapter. i'll put it on the table by the elevator.
Jamie: i'll also bring a small surge protector.
Lee: quick note for new folks: bring headphones if you want voice chat muted, we keep it low-decibel.
Priya: adding a tiny sign-up: first 4 players lock in the couch, others rotate.
Ariel: sample lineup I'm noting: Jamie (PS5), Sam (host PC), Lee (laptop), Priya (guest). more people can join rotating queue.
Sam: can someone grab a HDMI handoff reminder sticky? last time it wandered into storage. :laughing: 
Ariel: will do. i'll tape it to the mezz kitchenette.
Jamie: streaming? someone want to capture highlights?
Lee: i can run local recording if we need clips, but no full live stream—keep it internal.
Priya: perfect. see you all tonight. bringing extra napkins. :pizza:
